widgets_values: A bright and modern open-plan kitchen and living room with light wooden floors and warm natural lighting. In the foreground, a 3-year-old blonde girl with long straight hair, wearing an orange long-sleeve top and gray leggings, is sitting on the floor with arms spread wide, facing her mother. The mother, a white woman in her late 30s with golden-blonde hair and a relaxed smile, is sitting barefoot on a light gray sofa, reaching out with open arms to welcome her daughter. In the background, the father—a white man in his late 30s with short brown hair and a neatly groomed beard—is cooking at the kitchen counter. He wears a cream-colored sweater and dark jeans. The overall atmosphere is warm, relaxed, and filled with natural light. A vase of flowers sits on the wooden dining table to the right, and indoor plants add a touch of freshness.
